title: Cooler Case
content: Cooler case, gouache, casein, and colored pencils, 5 x 8 inchesIt's the quiet time at the diner, the middle of the afternoon, just a few regular customers.There's a cooler case behind the counter. Barb takes a sponge to the stainless steel doors, which reflect two wavy swirls of light. One swirl is the yellow fluorescent above our booth, and the other is the green trees outside.Barb calls out to Mel, "Don't let me go home without a piece of carrot cake or cheesecake. That's my treat to myself."
